extracted_claim: Depth buffer stores depth values per fragment (16, 24, or 32 bit). Depth testing is disabled by default. Enable with glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST). Must clear depth buffer each frame with glClear(GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT). Depth test compares fragment depth against buffer value. If test passes, fragment is rendered and depth buffer updated.
implementation_relevance: HSE should enable depth testing for correct 3D rendering. Currently HSE may not enable depth testing, which could cause rendering artifacts.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE Renderer may or may not enable GL_DEPTH_TEST. Need to check.

document_reference: Depth testing chapter, Depth test function section
extracted_claim: glDepthFunc controls depth comparison: GL_LESS (default, passes if fragment depth < buffer depth), GL_LEQUAL, GL_EQUAL, GL_GREATER, GL_GEQUAL, GL_NOTEQUAL, GL_ALWAYS, GL_NEVER. glDepthMask(GL_FALSE) makes depth buffer read-only.
implementation_relevance: HSE uses GL_LESS by default. Advanced techniques (shadow mapping) may require different depth functions.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: Depth function configuration not yet in HSE

document_reference: Depth testing chapter, Depth value precision and Z-fighting sections
extracted_claim: Depth values are non-linear (proportional to 1/z), giving high precision near the camera and low precision far away. Z-fighting occurs when two surfaces are too close for depth buffer precision. Prevention: (1) Never place objects too close, (2) Set near plane as far as possible, (3) Use higher precision depth buffer (32-bit).
implementation_relevance: HSE should use 24-bit or 32-bit depth buffer. The near/far plane ratio affects depth precision.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: Depth buffer precision not configured in HSE

extracted_claim: Early depth testing runs depth test before fragment shader, discarding invisible fragments early. Restriction: fragment shader must not write to gl_FragDepth. If fragment shader writes depth, early depth testing is impossible.
implementation_relevance: HSE shaders should avoid writing to gl_FragDepth to enable early depth testing optimization.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE shaders should be checked for gl_FragDepth writes
